_comment: Coordinate/greedy-style hyperparameter search. Each group changes only one hyperparameter and is selected by validation PR-AUC, never test metrics. Dropout candidates keep weight_decay=0.02 and learning_rate=3e-4 fixed. Weight-decay candidates keep dropout=0.30 and learning_rate=3e-4 fixed; its 0.02 reference is already the dropout=0.30 run. Learning-rate candidates keep dropout=0.30 and weight_decay=0.02 fixed.
_comment_early_stopping: 0 disables early stopping: every epoch always runs, so each experiment gets exactly the same budget and no comparison is confounded by one arm stopping sooner. Checkpoint SELECTION still happens -- the weights that get tested are the epoch with the best early_stopping_metric -- so the honest phrasing for a slide is 'N epocas fijas + seleccion de checkpoint por val PR-AUC', not 'early stopping'. It was 100 with fewer epochs than that, which could never fire.
